//: GIT-001: an Invariant for every repository.
text: Author and sign off commits only as your user's git identity, never an AI's; if `git config user.email` is unset or an AI's, ask whose to use rather than guess.
why: The standards make the human contributor the author and the signer of every commit; an AI is only ever a co-author.
enforced_by: the DCO check, which requires a Signed-off-by line but only counts such lines
the guard hook, which denies a commit git would author or sign off as an AI
to_add: a release of the standards carrying the commit-check rule that rejects AI authors and sign-offs that are not the author's
a cloud setup step that supplies the owner's identity
